claim: A freshly seeded flock of 72 starts with low directional agreement, because its headings are drawn uniformly.
derivation: E15 draws each heading uniformly on the circle, independently of the others.
For N independent uniform unit vectors, the length r of their mean satisfies P(r > x) ≈ exp(−N x²) for large N (the Rayleigh approximation).
With N = 72 and x = 0.4 that is exp(−11.52) ≈ 1e-5 per seed, so all eight seeds start below 0.4 unless the generator or the heading draw is broken.
This is a probabilistic bound, stated with its odds, not an exact value.
